title: Research: full-center U8 composition and bounded cleanup retiming
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Rebuild 48 full-center A-frame promotions on PR799/X4, compose them with
NewBArch's existing U8 donation/restore construction from PR869, and publish
a complete direct cost inventory and bounded cleanup retiming census.
The two edit orders produce the same scalar/frame word. On the promoted
base, U8 preserves the delta `{3:+16,4:-32,5:+16}` and raises the directly
priced conditional kappa from `0.001297089685005627` to
`0.001297336599319710` (gain `0.000000246914314083`). This is a scoped research
contribution, with no change to the selected result.

The full-center word has local mass 5642. Recounting all 36,288 physical helper
roles leaves idle `{1:1,3:1,44:1,48:2396}`, global mass 521280 and deficit
1984 at `m=73, W=7168`. A separate supplied profile with 12 fewer rank-48
idle children prices to `0.001672153593380162`, but no placement producing
that profile is claimed. The center interface changes from eight rank-8
frames to eight rank-9 frames; old-parent compatibility is a diagnostic and
does not decide the independent cost calculation. A complete new global
generation still needs compatible suppliers, placement and phase scheduling,
with inherited all-size, realization, precision/tape and analytic transfer
arguments. These finite checks do not establish the full multiplication theorem.

The cleanup study enumerates every permitted insertion position for one
ordinary cleanup gate with a disjoint ordinary prefix, exact scalar
commutation and minimal monotone tail-frame repair under fixed final caps.
It checks 17,399 candidates each on X4 and the promoted word, plus 19,082 on
the U8 composition. Every word has one valid profile, equal to its baseline;
there is no improvement in this specified class. Representative words and
the complete compressed census are retained. No global optimality is claimed.

Inputs are pinned to main `91a2094f2e022930069e8cfdc810a3ea1b81cd09`, the
committed PR799 replay archive, and PR869 head
`73e86f69bf9a391e3c334999f7bbe3825dc42759`. All four imported PR869 files
retain their exact Git blobs, source note and notices. The contribution
retains Jeremy Kothe, NewBArch, icekylinx, Chafik Boukhalfa,
DreamingOfClouds and the credited predecessor lineage.

Human/AI collaboration: **Liamia supplied theoretical guidance and
corrections; OpenAI Codex performed the concrete implementation and
verification.** New contributions are Apache-2.0.

## Validation

Passed locally with Python 3.14.3 on Windows:

- Exact rational scalar audit on all 728 columns in both orientations,
  including frame chains, entrance-zero responses, final helper cones and
  restoration, for the promoted word, U8, their composition and each retained
  distinct retiming-profile representative.
- Complete physical-role/idle recount; two retained exact rational moment
  engines; all 47 outer inequalities and their four arithmetic negative controls.
- All 36 combined donation/restore/order mutation controls rejected, with
  rejection stage recorded; 53,880 bounded retiming candidates classified.
- All 42 focused regression tests passed, including an independent matrix
  comparison of 1,764 rational primitive pairs, pin corruption, missing
  restoration and recompression/tampering checks.
- A separate directory with a space in its path, containing only the 53
  manifested public files, passed `python -B research/roadmap48/verify.py
  --check-committed`, reproducing all 28 public artifact bindings.
- Selected-result source/claim binding check and all five selected-result
  tests passed. All new source and artifact hashes were checked against the
  Git index; no selected package or `upstream/` file changes.

`make verify` was not run locally because make is unavailable. The unadapted
additional frontier799 binding suite is blocked at Windows symlink creation
(`WinError 1314`); it is included, together with the focused replay and
selected-result tests, in the new Linux/Python 3.11 and 3.14 workflow. Remote
CI status is separate from the local passes above. A selected-construction
cold replay is not claimed.

Retained compressed JSON bindings cover decompressed payloads; source text
uses LF normalization. Immutable input archives remain byte-exact, while
gzip container hashes and elapsed times are omitted from semantic receipts.
